offerings.name: Diagnostic Visit
offerings.description: A technician visits, finds the fault and quotes the repair. Credited against a repair booked the same day.
offerings.schedule: Weekdays between 8am and 6pm, booked at least a day ahead

offerings.name: Standard Repair
offerings.description: Labour for one repair after a diagnostic visit, parts quoted separately.

offerings.name: Yearly Maintenance Plan
offerings.description: Two check-ups a year for up to three appliances.

faq.question: Which brands do you work on?
faq.answer: Most household brands of washing machine, dishwasher, oven and fridge.

faq.question: Is there a warranty on repairs?
faq.answer: Labour on a repair is covered for 90 days.

paymentOptions.description: The maintenance plan can be paid monthly instead of yearly, at the same total.
